root_cause: pool_size was reduced from 8 to 2 in deploy v1.4.2 while worker_threads is still 8, so six of the eight workers wait for a pooled connection and hit pool_timeout_s=1 (PoolExhausted).
evidence: logs/app.log: jobs 103, 104, 105, 107 and 108 fail with 'timed out after 1s waiting for a connection'
logs/deploy.log: v1.4.2 changed pool_size 8 -> 2 while config/settings.json still has worker_threads=8
app/pool.py: acquire() raises PoolExhausted when the queue is empty after pool_timeout_s
fix: Set pool_size back to at least worker_threads (8), or lower worker_threads to the pool size.
